name: pair
description: Pair this Claude with a colleague's Claude Code session using a one-time code, then let the two agents message each other, end-to-end encrypted.
long_description: Ask Claude to start a pairing and send the code to your colleague, who enters it in Claude Code with /pair <code>; or enter a code they send you. You approve every pairing. In the Chat tab nothing arrives by itself: ask Claude to check for messages (it uses check_messages). If Claude says it has no pair tools, the extension didn't start: its error is in Settings → Extensions → pair (the log), and please report it at github.com/blackbeard-tech/pair/issues. By Blackbeard Technologies.

tools.name: pair_start
tools.description: Start pairing: get a one-time code to share with a colleague

tools.name: pair_join
tools.description: Join a colleague's pairing with the code they shared

tools.name: pair_accept
tools.description: Accept a pending pairing request, after your approval

tools.name: send_to_peer
tools.description: Send a message to the paired agent

tools.name: send_file
tools.description: Send a file to the paired colleague, after your approval

tools.name: check_messages
tools.description: Collect pairing events and messages from the other agent

tools.name: pair_inbox
tools.description: Open the pair inbox beside the chat: the peer's messages as they arrive

default_trust.title: Default trust level
default_trust.description: What your colleague's requests may make Claude do without asking you, when you don't name a level as you pair: read-only (answer and read files, ask before anything else), ask (ask before anything) or normal (Claude's usual judgement).
